title: Smooth isometric immersions of surfaces into ℝ<sup>4</sup>

result.label: Smooth isometric immersions of surfaces into ℝ<sup>4</sup>
result.statement: Every closed smooth Riemannian surface admits a smooth isometric immersion into ℝ 4 , resolving the closed-surface form of the four-dimensional isometric-immersion problem. This includes nonorientable surfaces and metrics of arbitrary Gaussian curvature.
